description: Apply IAS 10 (Events After Reporting Period) overlay to a prior calculation output. Classifies events as adjusting/non-adjusting, assesses going concern, generates adjusted journal entries. Most standards auto-trigger IAS 10 when subsequentEventDate + subsequentEventKind are provided — use this tool only for manual overlay or multi-standard combinations.

input.description: Required. The POST /ias10/apply body (also dividendsDeclaredAfterReporting, the IAS 10.14-16 going-concern facts, authorisedBy, ownersOrOthersHavePowerToAmendAfterIssue, id, entityId); any other key is refused by name.

authorisationDate.description: Required. Date the financial statements were authorised for issue, an ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD)

events.description: Required. Array of post-reporting-period events (IAS 10.3), each { eventId, eventDate, eventDescription, eventType, conditionExistedAtReportingDate?, adjustments?: [{ lineItem, sourcePath, originalAmount, adjustedAmount, reason?, expectedSettlementDate? / expectedRealisationDate? }], … }

functionalCurrency.description: Functional currency of the adjusting entries, an ISO 4217 string (e.g. "EUR"; IAS 21.8). Their XBRL tags carry it.

reportingDate.description: Required. Reporting date, an ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD)

sourceCalculation.description: Required. Object { standard, calculationOutput } — the data block of another ifr_calculate call and the standard that produced it (GENERAL_JOURNAL for a ledger no engine standard measured)

name: ifr_apply_ias10
